purpose: Establish whether a finite bulk burst adds fixed-ID small-response waiting on its shared outer beyond the common bottleneck seen on the other outer. Baseline mechanism only.

controls.origin_outbound_policy: same baseline namespace defaults; read back, no test-only lowat variation
controls.tls: 1.3; real CA verification; native AnyTLS auth and negotiated fixed padding

run_order_draft.phase: preGO healthy references then restricted burst
fresh resources/connections; same healthy references then restricted burst

time.quiet_scope: all heavy readiness finished; before/after raw cpu.stat/tasks identities; no adaptive waiting
time.controller_go_vs_client_base: retain both; client observed marker then establishes actual common worker base; planned timer offsets use that base

capacity.readiness_API_tcp_row_caps: 33 origin+33 proxy endpoints+4 external outer endpoints fit original512; actual filter/readback count still verified, never silently raised

network_draft.natural_equivalence: Does not reproduce actual WAN topology/loss/BBR mode; validates only declared finite-queue mechanism. Stage/TCP evidence required, nonzero rwnd and ACK progress within target interval.

budgets.raw_sources: all33 client slots,33 origin ledger entries, all16pair results; preserve missing/partial/errors
budgets.future_stage_poll: same10s/64KiB source cadence and budgets; do not increase for desired evidence

interpretation.claim_requires_both_bulk_placements: positive fixed-pair after-ready loaded-minus-independent contrast AND simultaneous ready small response, actual native TLSwrite pending, target writer-waiter evidence, identity-certain inside TCP ACK/rwnd/queue observations
interpretation.event_evidence: identity-certain TCP capture wholly inside selected origin-ready to client-verified interval plus matching session TLS/owner evidence; no arbitrary per-request operation mapping
strong_falsifiers: request scheduler or origin not ready
reader not armed or scheduling failure
interpretation.future_backpressure_candidate: Only after matching declared causal evidence; may shift delay into writer locks and cannot add WAN capacity. No lowat/CC/frame/scheduler change implemented.
interpretation.effective_sendbuffer: Read effective socket sndbuf/sk_wmem queue and TLS begin/end;6MiB load is a design to exceed buffering, not proof from tcp_wmem alone.
